tagline: A quiet haven in the heart of Chefchaouen, where every detail is made to feel like home.
experienceAuthentic: Experience authentic Moroccan hospitality in our beautifully restored riad. Each room is thoughtfully designed with traditional elements and modern comforts to ensure your stay is memorable and comfortable.
checkInFrom: Check-in: From 2:00 PM — Early check-in available upon request (subject to availability)
checkOutUntil: Check-out: Until 11:00 AM — Late check-out available upon request
receptionLocated: Reception is located in Section 3 and is staffed to welcome you on arrival
pleaseInform: Please inform us of your arrival time in advance so we can be ready for you
validID: A valid ID or passport is required at check-in
quietHours: Riad Nila is a peaceful boutique property — we kindly ask guests to respect quiet hours between 10:00 PM and 8:00 AM
noSmoking: No smoking inside the rooms or common areas — designated smoking areas are available
petsWelcome: Pets are welcome at Riad Nila — please note they are not allowed in the restaurant area
outsideFood: Outside food and beverages are not allowed in restaurant areas
fifteenRooms: 15 rooms across 3 sections, each with its own character and charm
roomsRange: Rooms range across different categories — ask our team for upgrade options
ourRestaurant: Our on-site restaurant serves traditional Moroccan cuisine and international dishes
breakfastServed: Breakfast is served every morning — please let us know your preferred time
lunchDinner: Lunch and dinner reservations recommended, especially in high season
guestsDine: Guests can choose to dine inside the restaurant or out on the terrace
locatedSection: Located in Section 3, our spa offers traditional hammam treatments and relaxation therapies
advanceBooking: Advance booking is strongly recommended — please book at least 2 days ahead
browseFull: You can browse the full treatment menu and more details in the Spa section of our website
openDaily: Open daily — ask reception for the current schedule
twoLevels: Two levels of terrace plus a 360° rooftop with panoramic views over the Medina
perfectFor: Perfect for sunrise, sunset, and stargazing — accessible to all guests
rooftopMay: Rooftop may close in extreme weather conditions
riadNilaJust: Riad Nila is just a 3-minute walk from Place Outa Hammam, the heart of the Medina — ideal for exploring souks, restaurants, and cultural sites
medinaStreets: The Medina streets are narrow and car-free — our team will guide you on your first walk out if needed
weRecommend: We recommend carrying a copy of our address written in Arabic to show taxi drivers or locals if you get turned around
bargaining: Bargaining is expected in the souks — take your time and enjoy the experience!
forTours: For tours, transport, dining recommendations and more, visit the Other Services section of our website
forGuests: For guests staying more than one night, our housekeeping team visits daily. Here's a simple way to communicate your towel preference:
towelsFloor: Towels left on the floor = please replace them
towelsHung: Towels hung up = I'm still using them, no change needed
smallGesture: This small gesture also helps us care for the environment — thank you!
freshOrangeJuice: Fresh Orange Juice is included for all guests.
mixedFruitPlate: One mixed fruit plate served for every two guests.
additionalFood: Any additional food or drinks requested outside the breakfast menu will be charged as an extra.
inRestaurant: In the restaurant located in Section 2 of the riad
pleaseNote: Please note that guest rooms are located throughout the riad's three sections.
readyBreakfast: Ready for breakfast? Please send us a WhatsApp message at least 10 minutes before your preferred breakfast time so we can prepare everything fresh for you.
ifYouDo: If you do not send a message in advance, you are welcome to come directly to the restaurant and ask a waiter to prepare your breakfast.
importantGuests: Important: Guests leaving before breakfast service begins should inform reception in advance. We will do our best to prepare a takeaway breakfast for early departures.
breakfastServedBetween: Breakfast is served between 8:00 AM and 10:00 AM daily.
maximumTwo: Maximum 2 people inside at the same time
nestled: Nestled in the heart of Chefchaouen's medina, Riad Nila is a beautifully restored traditional Moroccan riad that seamlessly blends authentic heritage with modern comfort. Each of our 15 rooms across three distinct sections has been thoughtfully designed to reflect the character and charm of this historic city.
weBelieve: We believe in creating a sanctuary where guests can experience genuine Moroccan hospitality. From our traditional hammam to our on-site restaurant serving authentic cuisine, every detail has been crafted to make you feel at home.
riadNilaOffers: Riad Nila offers a range of facilities designed for your comfort and enjoyment:
onSiteRestaurantServing: On-site restaurant serving traditional Moroccan and international cuisine
multipleTerraces: Multiple terraces and a 360° rooftop with panoramic medina views
authenticity: Authenticity - We honor Moroccan traditions while providing modern comforts
hospitality: Hospitality - Your comfort and satisfaction are our top priority
sustainability: Sustainability - We care for our environment and community
excellence: Excellence - We maintain the highest standards in every aspect of our service
lunchDinnerDesc: Discover our comprehensive selection of authentic Moroccan cuisine, from traditional soups and salads to signature tagines and grilled specialties.
reservationsRecommended: Reservations are recommended to ensure the best experience.
rooftopDesc: Enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of the Medina while savoring our carefully curated selection of desserts, hot drinks, and refreshing beverages. Perfect for sunrise, sunset, and stargazing.
rooftopNote: Open daily from sunset. Best reserved in advance for groups.
spaDesc: Indulge in authentic Moroccan spa treatments designed to rejuvenate your body and soul. Our experienced therapists use traditional techniques and natural products to create a sanctuary of peace and wellness.
spaBookingNote: Book your spa treatment in advance to secure your preferred time slot. Contact us via WhatsApp to make a reservation.
servicesDesc: Beyond accommodation and dining, we offer curated services to make your stay unforgettable. Our concierge team is dedicated to creating personalized experiences tailored to your interests.
conciergeAvailable: Our dedicated concierge team is available to assist with:
contactConcierge: Contact our concierge team to arrange any service or experience you desire.
haveBlueCity: A Haven in the Blue City
nestledEnchanting: Nestled in the enchanting medina of Chefchaouen, Riad Nila is a beautifully restored traditional Moroccan riad that embodies the essence of authentic hospitality. Our name, "Nila," reflects the serene blue hues that define this magical city.
everyCorner: Every corner of Riad Nila tells a story of careful restoration and thoughtful design, blending centuries-old architectural elements with modern comforts to create a sanctuary where guests can truly feel at home.
haveQuestions: Have questions or ready to book your stay? We'd love to hear from you.
